prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1100; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent the interests of our client in connection with injuries sustained in a recent motor vehicle collision involving your insured. The collision was a low-speed head-on impact, and our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation and treatment.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any communication received from your insured or any representative acting on your insured's behalf should be referred to us.

We request that you provide a complete statement of the liability coverage under the policy issued to your insured, including the bodily injury policy limits and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this matter.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event data recorder information, repair and total loss records, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, and any other documents or materials in your possession, custody, or control. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
